"Before" a certain year refers to the years that are *less than* that year.

options.alt: A horizontal number line has the following labels: 1977, 1987, 1997, 2007, and 2017. An open circle is drawn at 1997. The number line to the left of 1997 is labeled "before emoji". The number line to the right of 1997 is labeled "after emoji".

hints.content: Since $\tealE{y}$ represents the years *before* $1997$, $\tealE{y}$ is *less than* $\purpleD{1997}$.
